About Thangamani Palanivel

I'm Thangamani Palanivel (commonly known as Star), an active Full Stack Developer, UI/UX Designer, and Computer Applications (BCA) scholar studying at PGP College of Arts and Science in Namakkal, Tamil Nadu.

I specialize in engineering fluid frontends and connecting them with functional, performant backend architectures. My technical passion balances interactive UI programming with defensive development practices, drawing skills from advanced script frameworks, network diagnostic engines, and local platform layouts.

I am currently seeking professional Web Development and Graphic Design Internship tracks. Whether working remotely or on-site, I bring high-converting responsive interfaces, modular system architecture layouts, and clean user experience implementations.
